reviews.title: Works well
reviews.comment: Works well with the ASUS ROG Maximus z890 Hero. The motherboard required a firmware/bios update to the current release, but I was then able to use the XMP profile and the board took care of the rest. Solid memory! Very fast.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Intel Core Ultra 7 265K - MSI Z890 Tomahawk - Stable at 8000MT
reviews.comment:
This RAM kit has been INCREDIBLE for my Intel Core Ultra 7 265K. I upgraded from the G.Skill Flare Series 6000MT RAM kit which was giving me stability issues non stop even at 6000MT settings.
Here are the results/specs using an MSI Z890 Tomahawk motherboard:
Stable at 8000MT! Incredible performance and decent value although not the cheapest option out there.
reviews.author: Collin Computers

reviews.title: Finally stable fast ram
reviews.comment:
Finally I have fast and stable RAM. I went through so many different RAM kits and suffered through blue screens and crashes and constant issues - until I found this kit. It has been rock solid stable with XMP on my 265k overclock to 5.7Ghz and I havent had one crash and passed all stress tests.

GSkill Trident 48GB CUDIMM XMP 8200 MT
ASUS Rog Apex 890

reviews.title: Racer Fast
reviews.comment: With my ASUS Z890 BTF motherboard, these sticks run at 8400 m/t stable all day.  Just be sure to enable " ASUS multicore enhancement" and remove all limits.
reviews.author: Jeff Mitchell

reviews.title: Low Reliability
reviews.comment:
Did it work.  YEAH.  8400 on my 285K without any issue.  pass Mem86.  I was going to give it 5 star.  Until Today.  One Dimm died.  That is just 6 weeks.  My Asus Apex refuse to boot.  Got a QCode 55.  Memory not installed.  Its been working for 6 weeks.  To test, do 1 Dimm at a time. Sure enough, 1 of the DIMM boot up fine.  Put another dimm in, Q55.  Start RMA process.
In mean Time i put my old trust  F5-7200J3445G16GX2-TZ5RK back.  System boot up fine now...
